description:
PCS season is coming 🇺🇸
And yes — your home can be ready before you even arrive.

My client is still stationed in Hawaii, buying her very first home from miles away wasn’t easy… but she trusted a 𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐭 𝐇𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐚 𝐑𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐭𝐨𝐫 who understands military moves.

After touring 10+ homes virtually, she chose a Prescott floor plan in Nolanville with an incredible 𝟑.𝟗𝟗% 𝐕𝐀  𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞 ✨
Today I placed the 𝐒𝐎𝐋𝐃 sign so her home will be waiting when she PCS’s in April 🏡

If you’re stationed overseas or out of state, I’ve got you.
𝐕𝐢𝐫𝐭𝐮𝐚𝐥 𝐭𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬 ✔️
𝐖𝐞𝐞𝐤𝐥𝐲 𝐮𝐩𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬 ✔️
𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐨𝐭𝐡 𝐏𝐂𝐒 𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 ✔️

Your home should be the easiest part of your move.
